name: curtain-spec-pack
description: v0.31.5.303 visual verification: the Curtain specification table in the curtains trade pack. Seven columns on a pack sheet is a real overflow risk, so the point is legibility, not just presence.

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml=null; window.open=function(){ return { document:{ write:function(html){ window.__capturedHtml=html }, close:function(){} }, close:function(){}, focus:function(){}, print:function(){} }; };

waitFor.store: window.__packErr ? (() => { throw new Error(window.__packErr) })() : (typeof window.__capturedHtml === 'string' && window.__capturedHtml.length > 0)

steps.name: assert-spec-table
steps.eval: (function(){ const h=window.__capturedHtml; if(!/Curtain specification/.test(h)) throw new Error('no Curtain specification table in the pack'); if(!/Floor drop/.test(h)) throw new Error('no floor-drop column'); })()

steps.name: assert-no-column-overflow
steps.eval: (function(){ const th=[...document.querySelectorAll('td')].find(e=>/Curtain specification/.test(e.textContent||'')) || [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>/Curtain specification/.test(e.textContent||'')); if(!th) throw new Error('spec heading not rendered'); const tbl=th.parentElement?.querySelector('table.sched') || th.nextElementSibling; const t = tbl && tbl.tagName === 'TABLE' ? tbl : th.parentElement.querySelectorAll('table.sched')[1]; if(!t) throw new Error('spec table not found in the DOM'); if (t.scrollWidth > t.clientWidth + 2) throw new Error('the specification table overflows its container: scrollWidth '+t.scrollWidth+' vs clientWidth '+t.clientWidth); th.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
